definition: Bounded PHB2014 Skilled source-and-real-class-ASI API proof. It does not establish all-tool support, generic mixed grants, browser correctness, server persistence or publication.
boundaries: Exactly18 PHB skills,37 concrete PHB tools and2 vehicle proficiency kinds; group entries, individual carts/boats, air vehicles and unreviewed SCAG/magic domains are not silently granted. Unsupported does not mean RAW forbidden.
All selections share one count3 and require explicit current intent. Existing proficiency is legal, does not double PB or convert to expertise, and does not produce automatic replacement choices.
Source hashes bind this source audit; runtime mechanical identity checks do not cryptographically authenticate imported publisher prose.
No creation of tool inventory, crafting, tool attack rolls, vehicle control subsystem, language grants or Linguist ability/cipher logic.
Manual tools including an empty string remain authoritative; skill contribution is independent. HP, resources, attributes, manual overrides and old reviewed-feat domains remain untouched.

Independent version1 domain preserves prior reviewedFeats v1. Actual old consumer retains opaque new intent but can preserve stale intent after clear/reselect; old-client editing is not safe compatibility. Withdraw and reconfirm in a new client after such editing.

Native single/collection and linked native payload are verified at the API layer. Thin legacy Owlbear tool arrays remain empty. Actual browser storage, cloud delivery and deployment are separate gates.
Generic mixed-proficiency-choice remains unsupported in Data IR. No old full corpus replay or altered denominator is claimed.

publicReference.summary: Each specific artisan tool, game set and instrument has separate proficiency; vehicle proficiency is a land or water kind. Tool checks are not tied to a fixed ability.
